question: With Feed A and Feed B flow rates as the manipulated variables, what RMSE and maximum overshoot did the SAC controller of the lab-scale CSTR have?
rendered:
<document title="Reinforcement Learning-Based Temperature Control of Lab-Scale Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor">

=== page 13 ===
- Both reinforcement learning techniques can successfully control the nonlinear CSTR temperature, as evidenced by the reactor temperature after the reference changes at roughly 30 °C, 35 °C, 43 °C, 37 °C, and 40 °C. The TD3 controller offers a somewhat smoother and more reliable response when it comes to temperature tracking.
- While Feed B’s temperature stays near 45 °C, Feed A’s temperature stays near 34 °C. This demonstrates that TD3 finds a manipulated-variable strategy that is more stable and has less actuator variation.
